data.name: Sprocket.GravityFit.Extents
data.comment: A button in a gravity generator's terminal that sizes its field to cover every block of its grid. Also the title of the message box that button can show.

data.name: Sprocket.GravityFit.ExtentsAbout
data.value: Size the field to cover every block of this grid.
data.comment: The tooltip on the button in a gravity generator's terminal that sizes its field to cover every block of its grid.

data.name: Sprocket.GravityFit.Interior
data.comment: A button in a gravity generator's terminal that sizes its field to cover every pressurized room of its grid. Also the title of the message boxes that button can show.

data.name: Sprocket.GravityFit.InteriorAbout
data.value: Size the field to cover every pressurized room of this grid. Needs pressurization on in the world's settings.
data.comment: The tooltip on the button in a gravity generator's terminal that sizes its field to cover every pressurized room of its grid. The button is greyed out where the world has pressurization off.

data.name: Sprocket.GravityFit.NoRooms
data.value: This grid has no pressurized rooms, so the field is left as it was.
data.comment: A message box shown after the button in a gravity generator's terminal that fits the field to the pressurized rooms is pressed, where the grid has no pressurized rooms.

data.name: Sprocket.GravityFit.Short
data.value:
The field is as large as this generator allows, and still falls short. It needs {needed} and reaches {reached}.
For half a minute, a red box shows what it has to cover, and a white box how far it reaches.
data.comment: A message box shown after either autofit button in a gravity generator's terminal is pressed, where the field needed is larger than the generator can make. {needed} and {reached} are sizes, width by height by depth in meters.
